sources.title: Myanmar eVisa: Notice to Tourist Visa Applicants
sources.officialityEvidence: The live eVisa service is hosted on the Ministry of Immigration and Population's moip.gov.mm subdomain and its current landing page identifies itself as Myanmar eVisa Official Government. The Tourist notice is a first-party route of that service.

sources.title: Myanmar eVisa: live Frequently Asked Questions data
sources.officialityEvidence: This is the live public FAQ data asset served by the official Myanmar eVisa service on evisa.moip.gov.mm. It supplies the active portal's eligibility and issuance answers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of 100 countries are eligible for a Tourist eVisa.

sources.title: List of Countries Having Bilateral Visa Exemption Agreements with Myanmar
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Myanmar
sources.officialityEvidence: The current two-page schedule is published directly on the Myanmar Ministry of Foreign Affairs mofa.gov.mm domain and is dated 27 January 2026.
sources.supportingExcerpt: List of Countries Having Bilateral Visa Exemption Agreements with Myanmar (As of 27 January 2026).

unresolved.reason: The current official eVisa FAQ limits Tourist eVisa eligibility to a named 100-country cohort; it does not establish this ordinary passport as eligible. Its approval letter is issued before travel but the visa is stamped at the immigration counter, and the FAQ expressly says that eVisa is not a visa on arrival. The current MFA bilateral schedule does not name this passport for an ordinary-passport waiver. No current official source examined establishes a tourist VOA or mission/advance-visa route for this code, so no status is inferred from omission.
